mentions.name: UltiMidi
mentions.description: A music game platform the author is almost ready to release at ultimidi.com. It is not a rhythm game yet, but the goal is to add more mini-games including rhythm games, and more instruments: it currently has piano, with guitar and ukulele planned and drums uncertain. It grows out of the author's earlier university project that used a basic neural network to detect exactly which guitar string and fret was played, and an earlier small game playable with a real guitar.
mentions.source_excerpt: Since then I wanted to develop further such a game, and now I'm almost ready to release https://ultimidi.com , check it out, it's not really a rhythm game, but my goal is to add more mini-games to it (including rhythm games) and more instruments (now has piano, but planning to add guitar, ukulele too, not sure if drums would work too).
